text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, about tomorrow's training. I'd
like to do
something to clear my mind.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
So, could you bring some clay tiles
tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I thought long and hard about the best
way to do
it, and I settled on smashing
some tiles with my
bare fists, followed
by a refreshing run.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Good idea, right?! I'd even call it great! Starting tomorrow, I'm gonna smash through that new routine!
